tool.name: lowest common ancestor

param.name: lca_id_top
param.label: Top unique percentage identity values to consider
param.help: Uses the lowest unique percentage identity among the top N hits found per OTU.

param.name: lca_id_delta
param.label: Lower threshold with this value
param.help: Subtract the selected value from the percentage identity threshold initially found by the 'Top unique percentage identity values to consider' option.

tool.command: python3 '$__tool_directory__/lca.py' --input_file $input --output_file $output --bitscore $bitscore -id $identity -cov $coverage --tophit $setting_mode.setting #if $setting_mode.setting == "best_hit" or $setting_mode.setting == "best_hits_range" -tid $setting_mode.tophitid -tcov $setting_mode.tophitcoverage #elif $setting_mode.setting == "lca_threshold": --lca_id_top $setting_mode.lca_id_top --lca_id_delta $setting_mode.lca_id_delta #end if #if $filterhits -fl $filterhits #end if #if $filterlcahits -flh $filterlcahits #end if -minbit $minbitscore #if $filtersource -fs $filtersource #end if

param.name: setting
param.label: Settings mode
param.option: Output the top hit as species identification if it is above the choosen treshold
Output all top hits above treshold
Compute LCA on all hits above threshold

param.name: filterhits
param.label: Dont use hits containing this taxonomy:

param.name: filtersource
param.label: Dont use hits with taxonomy from:
